description: Merge an open PR. Enforces the same checks as the HTTP merge flow: not a draft, head SHA resolves, GateTest+AI-review hard gates pass, branch-protection rules satisfied. M3: soft-blocks when the pre-merge risk score is `critical` unless `confirm_high_risk: true` is passed. A refusal only because GateTest has not posted its verdict yet carries `retry: {after: "gatetest_verdict", headSha}`: the request is not remembered — call again once GateTest has answered for that head, or arm auto-merge (merjax_set_auto_merge), which is attempted when the verdict lands. Returns {merged, sha?, reason?, riskScore?, missingChecks?, retry?}.

confirm_high_risk.description: When true, bypass the M3 risk-score soft-block on critical-band PRs.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: merjax_merge_pr
